title: Eustathius, Prooemium to the Pindar Commentary / Евстафий Солунский, Предисловие к комментарию на Пиндара
author: Eustathius of Thessalonica
edition: Printed in Drachmann, Scholia vetera III (1927), pp. ~285ff., PD. Tafel 1832 PD. Kambylis 1991 (in copyright).
ru_evidence: No Russian translation listed in ru-wiki or ancientrome.ru, and Russian searches found none.
en_evidence: English Wikipedia lists only the Tafel 1832 and Schneidewin 1837 editions. No English translation found.
other_translations: German: Kambylis 1991. Italian: Negri 2000. Both from bibliographic knowledge, not re-verified online.
value: The only surviving part of Eustathius' Pindar commentary: a Byzantine theory of lyric, the life of Pindar and anecdotes (e.g., Pan singing Pindar's paean). A small, self-contained opener for a Pindar series.
ai_feasibility: High. Short and coherent, so the whole text can be multi-reviewed. The Atticizing style needs care.
